(i) **$(219.5)_{10} = (\text{?})_2$**
- Integer part ($219$):
  - $219 / 2 = 109$ remainder $1$
  - $109 / 2 = 54$ remainder $1$
  - $54 / 2 = 27$ remainder $0$
  - $27 / 2 = 13$ remainder $1$
  - $13 / 2 = 6$ remainder $1$
  - $6 / 2 = 3$ remainder $0$
  - $3 / 2 = 1$ remainder $1$
  - $1 / 2 = 0$ remainder $1$
  Integer in binary: $(11011011)_2$
- Fractional part ($0.5$):
  - $0.5 \times 2 = 1.0 ightarrow 	ext{carry } 1$
  Fraction in binary: $(.1)_2$
- **Result:** $(11011011.1)_2$

(ii) **$(A12B)_{16} = (\text{?})_8$**
- Convert Hexadecimal to Binary first:
  - $A_{16} = 1010_2$, $1_{16} = 0001_2$, $2_{16} = 0010_2$, $B_{16} = 1011_2$
  - Binary: $1010\,0001\,0010\,1011_2$
- Group into sets of 3 from right to left for Octal:
  - $001\,010\,000\,100\,101\,011_2$
  - Octal: $(120453)_8$

(iii) **Gray code $(1100110101)_2$ to Binary:**
- MSB remains the same: $B_9 = G_9 = 1$
- $B_8 = B_9 \oplus G_8 = 1 \oplus 1 = 0$
- $B_7 = B_8 \oplus G_7 = 0 \oplus 0 = 0$
- $B_6 = B_7 \oplus G_6 = 0 \oplus 0 = 0$
- $B_5 = B_6 \oplus G_5 = 0 \oplus 1 = 1$
- $B_4 = B_5 \oplus G_4 = 1 \oplus 1 = 0$
- $B_3 = B_4 \oplus G_3 = 0 \oplus 0 = 0$
- $B_2 = B_3 \oplus G_2 = 0 \oplus 1 = 1$
- $B_1 = B_2 \oplus G_1 = 1 \oplus 0 = 1$
- $B_0 = B_1 \oplus G_0 = 1 \oplus 1 = 0$
- **Result:** $(1000100110)_2$
proTip: When converting Hex to Octal, always convert via Binary as an intermediate step to avoid calculation errors.
